securityNotes: Read all three files in full at the pinned SHA. Prose plus grep patterns and a markdown plan template; read-only on source (Hard Rule 1/2: never modifies source code, no installs/builds/commits, only writes under plans/). Explicitly treats repository content as data and instructs flagging any file that tries to steer the agent -- a built-in anti-prompt-injection safeguard. The 'execute <plan>' invocation variant dispatches an executor subagent in an isolated worktree, which is a described, bounded feature rather than an uncontrolled action. No network calls, no credential handling. Clean.

proposedEntry.name: improve-animations
proposedEntry.description: Surveys a codebase's animation and motion code as a senior motion advisor and produces a prioritized, vetted findings table plus self-contained implementation plans any agent (including a weaker model with zero context) can execute without judgment of its own. Four phases: recon (stack, motion libraries, existing tokens, frequency map), an eight-category parallel audit (purpose/frequency, easing/duration, physicality/origin, interruptibility, performance, accessibility, cohesion, missed opportunities) with three effort levels, re-vetting every finding against its cited file:line before presenting a leverage-ordered severity table, then writing plans with exact target values, repo-convention exemplars, ordered steps, hard scope boundaries and a feel-check verification section. Read-only on source; only writes plan files.
triggers: improve the animations in this codebase
audit the motion in this app
give me a roadmap of animation fixes
inputs: a codebase to audit for animation/motion quality
optionally an effort level (quick/standard/deep) or a category focus
outputs: a vetted, severity-ranked findings table with leverage ordering
self-contained implementation plans written to plans/NNN-slug.md
a plans/README.md with recommended execution order and dependencies
